_meta.source: UN DESA Population Division, International Migrant Stock 2020 (Table 1, both-sexes 2020 column)
_meta.note: Bilateral migrant stocks (diaspora populations). Key 'origin_destination' (e.g., MEX_USA = number of Mexican-born people living in USA in 2020). Used as a proxy for diaspora-driven travel flows that pure gravity models systematically under-predict.
